lines.zh: 影子贴着地面滑，我踩不出声。
lines.en: I slide along the ground and leave no footfalls.

lines.zh: 我小跑时尾巴先拐弯。
lines.en: When I trot, my tail takes the corner first.

lines.zh: 屋檐下太亮，我换到墙根走。
lines.en: Too bright under the eaves; I move to the wall's shade.

lines.zh: 四只小爪轮流落地，像雨点。
lines.en: Four little paws land in turn, like raindrops.

lines.zh: 我绕着灯笼走，那股甜味在勾我。
lines.en: I circle the lantern; that sweetness is pulling at me.

lines.zh: 石阶太高，我一次跳两级。
lines.en: The steps are too tall, so I hop two at a time.

lines.zh: 我在草丛里穿行，草尖全歪了。
lines.en: I slip through the grass, bending every tip.

lines.zh: 肚子空着，我走路也没力气。
lines.en: With an empty belly, even my walking is weak.

lines.zh: 我朝怪物的方向小步逼近。
lines.en: I creep toward the monster in short little steps.

lines.zh: 影子拖在我身后，比我长得多。
lines.en: My shadow trails behind me, far longer than I am.

lines.zh: 我闻着糖味一路小跑过去。
lines.en: I trot the whole way, following a smell of sugar.

lines.zh: 走快了我会被自己的尾巴绊住。
lines.en: If I go too fast, my own tail trips me.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，只露出两只眼。
lines.en: I curl into a ball and show only two eyes.

lines.zh: 呜咽声从我喉咙里漏出来。
lines.en: A whimper leaks out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我数着远处的脚步声，一、二。
lines.en: I count distant footsteps: one, two.

lines.zh: 甜味还没来，我舔了舔牙。
lines.en: No sweetness yet; I lick my teeth.

lines.zh: 我把自己挂在阴影的边缘。
lines.en: I hang at the very edge of the shadow.

lines.zh: 尖叫声卡在喉咙里，我咽回去。
lines.en: A scream sticks in my throat; I swallow it.

lines.zh: 我盯着一只蠹虫，忍住了没叫。
lines.en: I stare at a silverfish and hold my scream.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖耳朵，落下一层灰。
lines.en: I shake my ears and a layer of dust falls.

lines.zh: 我假寐，耳朵却一直竖着。
lines.en: I pretend to sleep, but my ears stay up.

lines.zh: 肚子叫了一声，比我还响。
lines.en: My stomach growls louder than I do.

lines.zh: 你手里有糖吗？我闻到了。
lines.en: Do you have sweets? I can smell them.

lines.zh: 我仰头看你，眼睛眯成缝。
lines.en: I look up at you, eyes narrowed to slits.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子了，往旁边点。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow; move aside a bit.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，看谁先移开目光。
lines.en: I do not blink; let us see who looks away first.

lines.zh: 你口袋在响，是纸包糖吗？
lines.en: Your pocket rustles; is that wrapped candy?

lines.zh: 我歪头，估算你比我高多少。
lines.en: I tilt my head and judge your height.

lines.zh: 你是怪物，还是带糖的人？
lines.en: Are you a monster, or a person with sugar?

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一声轻轻的呜咽。
lines.en: A soft whimper rolls out of my throat.

lines.zh: 别伸手太快，我会先咬一口。
lines.en: Do not reach too fast; I bite first.

lines.zh: 我看的是你的手指，不是眼睛。
lines.en: My eyes are on your fingers, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 疼！我的尖叫卡在喉咙里。
lines.en: It hurts! My scream jams in my throat.

lines.zh: 我蜷起来，用尾巴挡住软肚子。
lines.en: I curl tight, tail shielding my soft belly.

lines.zh: 靴底压下来，我的骨头在叫。
lines.en: Your boot comes down; my bones complain.

lines.zh: 我呜咽着往后退了两步。
lines.en: I whimper and back away two steps.

lines.zh: 这伤比我整只还大。
lines.en: This wound is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上刮出声音。
lines.en: My claws scrape a sound out of the ground.

lines.zh: 别打了，我还没吃到糖。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I have not had my sugar yet.

lines.zh: 我耳朵贴平，牙却还露着。
lines.en: My ears flatten, but my teeth stay bared.

lines.zh: 血滴在影子上，看不见。
lines.en: Blood drips onto my shadow, unseen.

lines.zh: 我咬紧牙，没让自己叫出来。
lines.en: I clench my teeth and keep the scream in.

lines.zh: 甜的！我整只都贴上来了。
lines.en: Sweet! I press my whole body against it.

lines.zh: 一块曲奇换我不尖叫，成交。
lines.en: One cookie and I will not scream. Deal.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜瓶给我，我舔到瓶底。
lines.en: Give me the honey bottle; I will lick it dry.

lines.zh: 蛋糕屑也算，我不挑。
lines.en: Cake crumbs count too; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 糖粒粘在我鼻尖上，别拿走。
lines.en: Sugar sticks to my nose; do not take it.

lines.zh: 我先咬一小口，就一小口。
lines.en: I will take one small bite. Just one.

lines.zh: 甜浆果的汁顺着我下巴流。
lines.en: Berry juice runs down my chin.

lines.zh: 吃了这个，我就能去吓怪物。
lines.en: After this, I can go scare the monsters.

lines.zh: 我抱着南瓜派不撒手。
lines.en: I cling to the pumpkin pie and will not let go.

lines.zh: 再给一块，我就承认你是朋友。
lines.en: One more piece and I will call you a friend.

lines.zh: 你撞得我翻了个身，糖差点掉了。
lines.en: You knocked me over; I almost dropped my sugar.

lines.zh: 我贴着你腿滑过去，没让路。
lines.en: I slide past your leg and do not yield.

lines.zh: 我的爪子勾住你的靴子了。
lines.en: My claws snag on your boot.

lines.zh: 让开，我正追着甜味跑。
lines.en: Move; I am chasing a sweet smell.

lines.zh: 我被挤到墙角，尖叫了一声。
lines.en: Squeezed into the corner, I let out a scream.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的膝盖，弹回去半步。
lines.en: I hit your knee and bounce back half a step.

lines.zh: 别踩着我的尾巴，它很细。
lines.en: Do not step on my tail; it is very thin.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我闻到你手上的糖。
lines.en: We collide, and I smell sugar on your hands.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边钻过去，像一阵风。
lines.en: I slip under your feet like a draft.

lines.zh: 撞完之后，我瞪了你一眼。
lines.en: After the bump, I give you one glare.

lines.zh: 影子深处有另一只我，我叫它。
lines.en: Another me waits deep in the shadow; I call to it.

lines.zh: 我把甜的留一半给同伴。
lines.en: I save half the sweets for my companion.

lines.zh: 两只轻影贴在一起，像一块黑布。
lines.en: Two Shadelets press together like one black cloth.

lines.zh: 我们互相理毛，谁也不叫。
lines.en: We groom each other and neither of us screams.

lines.zh: 它的呜咽比我的更低一点。
lines.en: Its whimper is a little lower than mine.

lines.zh: 我绕它转圈，尾巴扫过地面。
lines.en: I circle it, tail brushing the ground.

lines.zh: 同伴来了，我的胆子也大了。
lines.en: With my companion here, my courage grows.

lines.zh: 我们并排蹲着，等同一块糖。
lines.en: We crouch side by side, waiting for the same sweet.

lines.zh: 它舔我耳朵，我假装很烦。
lines.en: It licks my ear; I pretend to be annoyed.

lines.zh: 两个影子叠在一起，分不清谁是谁。
lines.en: Two shadows overlap; no one can tell which is which.

lines.zh: 我叼起糖粒，牙都黏住了。
lines.en: I pick up a sugar grain and my teeth stick together.

lines.zh: 这块曲奇归我了，我先藏的。
lines.en: This cookie is mine; I hid it first.

lines.zh: 我拖着蛋糕走，比我还大。
lines.en: I drag the cake along; it is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 我把亮晶晶的东西塞进影子里。
lines.en: I stuff something shiny into the shadow.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，就是没人要的。
lines.en: If it fell on the ground, nobody wants it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴接住浆果，没让它沾土。
lines.en: I catch the berry in my mouth before it touches dirt.

lines.zh: 这瓶蜂蜜我抱不动，还是拖着。
lines.en: I cannot lift this honey; I drag it anyway.

lines.zh: 我藏了一颗糖，明天再吃。
lines.en: I hide one candy to eat tomorrow.

lines.zh: 骨头？不要，我只要甜的。
lines.en: A bone? No. I only want sweet things.

lines.zh: 我咬着东西跑，尾巴翘得很高。
lines.en: I run off with my prize, tail held high.

lines.zh: 那边有只僵尸，我去尖叫给它听。
lines.en: There is a zombie; I will go scream at it.

lines.zh: 怪物出现了，我牙根发痒。
lines.en: A monster appears, and my gums itch.

lines.zh: 我盯上那只苦力怕的脚后跟。
lines.en: I fix on that creeper's heels.

lines.zh: 目标找到了，它比我大三倍。
lines.en: Target found. It is three times my size.

lines.zh: 我先叫一声，让它回头看我。
lines.en: I scream first so it turns to look at me.

lines.zh: 那只骷髅的骨头在响，我听见了。
lines.en: That skeleton's bones rattle; I hear them.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，朝怪物的影子扑去。
lines.en: I lower myself and lunge at the monster's shadow.

lines.zh: 怪物越凶，我越想吓它一跳。
lines.en: The fiercer the monster, the more I want to startle it.

lines.zh: 我选定你了，别以为我小。
lines.en: I have chosen you; do not think I am small.

lines.zh: 蛛网那边有动静，我凑过去。
lines.en: Something moves by the web; I creep closer.

lines.zh: 它把后背留给我，机会来了。
lines.en: It leaves me its back; my chance is here.

lines.zh: 我深吸一口气，准备那声尖叫。
lines.en: I take a deep breath for that scream.

lines.zh: 这个目标闻起来像腐肉和铁。
lines.en: This target smells of rotten flesh and iron.

lines.zh: 我尾巴绷直，锁定了它。
lines.en: My tail goes stiff; I have it locked.

lines.zh: 那只蜘蛛从洞里出来了，我去吓它。
lines.en: That spider came out of its hole; I'll go scare it.

lines.zh: 它们没看见我，这正是我要的。
lines.en: They haven't seen me; that is exactly what I want.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，找它看不见的角度。
lines.en: I circle it, hunting the angle it cannot see.

lines.zh: 它一回头，我就缩进影子里。
lines.en: When it turns, I shrink into the shadow.

lines.zh: 我的尖叫在喉咙里攒着，快了。
lines.en: My scream gathers in my throat; almost there.

lines.zh: 它抬脚了，我数着落点。
lines.en: It lifts a foot; I count where it will land.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面跟，爪尖不出声。
lines.en: I follow low to the ground, claws silent.

lines.zh: 它没发现我，这让我很想笑。
lines.en: It has not spotted me, and that makes me want to laugh.

lines.zh: 我绕到它背后，尾巴扫过尘土。
lines.en: I slip behind it, tail sweeping the dust.

lines.zh: 等它靠近墙，我就叫。
lines.en: Once it nears the wall, I will scream.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，压住那声呜咽。
lines.en: I bite down and hold back the whimper.

lines.zh: 它的影子归我了，我踩上去。
lines.en: Its shadow is mine; I step onto it.

lines.zh: 我不急着扑，先让它心慌。
lines.en: I do not rush; first I let it grow uneasy.

lines.zh: 它挪一步，我就缩短一截距离。
lines.en: Each step it takes shortens the gap by an inch.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的喉咙，那里会响。
lines.en: I watch its throat; that is where sound comes from.

lines.zh: 时机到了，我弓起背。
lines.en: The moment comes; I arch my back.

lines.zh: 我沿墙根溜，影子比我先到。
lines.en: I slip along the wall base; my shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 我数它的脚步，一下都不漏。
lines.en: I count its steps and miss none.

lines.zh: 它低头的时候，我往前挪一寸。
lines.en: When it lowers its head, I creep an inch closer.

lines.zh: 我的呜咽憋在嗓子里，等它靠近。
lines.en: I hold my whimper back until it comes closer.

lines.zh: 它转圈，我也转，总在它背后。
lines.en: It circles; I circle too, always behind it.

lines.zh: 我把牙磨好，等那一瞬。
lines.en: I grind my teeth and wait for the moment.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着扑上去，咬它脚踝。
lines.en: I lunge screaming and bite its ankle.

lines.zh: 这一口很小，但很尖。
lines.en: It is a small bite, but a sharp one.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划过去，留下四道白痕。
lines.en: My claws rake past and leave four white lines.

lines.zh: 它被我的叫声吓得退了一步。
lines.en: My scream makes it stagger back a step.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，牙陷进腐肉里。
lines.en: I bite and hold, teeth sunk into rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 我用整只身体撞它的膝盖。
lines.en: I throw my whole body at its knee.

lines.zh: 尖叫贴着它耳朵炸开。
lines.en: The scream bursts right against its ear.

lines.zh: 它挥手打我，我从下面钻过去。
lines.en: It swings at me; I duck underneath.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退，绝不站原地。
lines.en: I bite, then retreat; I never stand still.

lines.zh: 这一下是替那块蛋糕打的。
lines.en: This one is for that piece of cake.

lines.zh: 我的牙卡在它的护甲缝里。
lines.en: My teeth lodge in a gap of its armor.

lines.zh: 它怕了，我看得出它怕了。
lines.en: It is afraid; I can see that it is afraid.

lines.zh: 我从它背后咬了一口就跑。
lines.en: I bite from behind and then run.

lines.zh: 别小看我，我的尖叫能钻进骨头。
lines.en: Do not underestimate me; my scream gets into bone.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，牙先咬住它的手指。
lines.en: I leap and my teeth find its fingers first.

lines.zh: 我的尖叫在洞里回头，变成两声。
lines.en: My shriek bounces back off the cave as two.

lines.zh: 它挥过来，我从它胯下滑走。
lines.en: It swings; I slide out between its legs.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在膝盖后面，最软。
lines.en: This bite lands behind the knee, where it is softest.

lines.zh: 我咬着它的影子，它就开始怕。
lines.en: I bite down on its shadow and it starts to fear.

lines.zh: 我抓完就蹿上墙，冲它叫。
lines.en: I scratch and dart up the wall to shriek at it.

lines.zh: 我从最暗的墙角里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the darkest corner.

lines.zh: 先是一声呜咽，然后我才睁眼。
lines.en: First a whimper, then I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 影子抖了一下，我就在那儿了。
lines.en: The shadow twitches, and there I am.

lines.zh: 我落地时没有声音，只有爪尖。
lines.en: I land silently, save for my claw tips.

lines.zh: 这地方有糖味吗？我先闻闻。
lines.en: Is there sugar here? Let me sniff first.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先出来，身体才跟上。
lines.en: My tail comes out first; the rest follows.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，露出满口小牙。
lines.en: I yawn and show a mouthful of tiny teeth.

lines.zh: 四周太亮了，我往暗处挪。
lines.en: It is too bright; I shuffle toward the dark.

lines.zh: 我刚出生就饿了，这很正常。
lines.en: I am hungry the moment I appear; that is normal.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的影屑，站稳。
lines.en: I shake off the shadow dust and find my feet.

lines.zh: 有个怪物在附近，我听见了。
lines.en: A monster is nearby; I hear it.

lines.zh: 我来了，带着一声很轻的尖叫。
lines.en: I arrive with one very soft scream.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的毛，甜味变焦味。
lines.en: Fire singes my fur; sweetness turns to char.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，我先找影子落地。
lines.en: Falling, I aim for a shadow to land in.

lines.zh: 水灌进耳朵，我的尖叫变成气泡。
lines.en: Water fills my ears; my scream becomes bubbles.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀飞，糖也撒了。
lines.en: The blast throws me; my sugar scatters too.

lines.zh: 箭把我钉在地上，尾巴还在动。
lines.en: An arrow pins me down; my tail still moves.

lines.zh: 有股冷东西钻进我的影子。
lines.en: Something cold crawls into my shadow.

lines.zh: 我饿得连尖叫都没力气。
lines.en: I am too hungry to manage even a scream.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的毛全竖着。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; every hair on me stands up.

lines.zh: 我一直往下掉，影子追不上我。
lines.en: I keep falling, and my shadow cannot keep up.
